function bisect(f, a, b, tol)
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    if abs(b - a) < tol
        return mid
    elseif hasroot(f, a, mid)
        return bisect(f, a, mid, tol)
    else
        return bisect(f, mid, b, tol)
    end
end

Data structures are often optimized for appending rather than prepending.

function bisect_iter(f, a, b, tol)
    hist = Float64[]
    while abs(b - a) > tol
        mid = (a + b) / 2
        push!(hist, mid)
        if hasroot(f, a, mid)
            b = mid
        else
            a = mid
        end
    end
    hist
end
